title: feat(formula): a CEL syntax refusal keeps the engine's fault code and source range (#27904)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XKy1Tn6rK9yK1erywxCx5Bk)_

Fixes #27904

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：公式引擎拒绝一条写错的 CEL 表达式时，除了原来那句英文，现在还带上引擎自己的错误类别（比如「缺一个右括号」「多了一个不认识的字符」）和出错的字符位置。
- **为什么改**：编辑器之前只能显示一句笼统的「语法错误」加原始报错，没法用用户的语言说「第 17 个字符处缺一个右括号」，也没法把光标指到出错处。
- **风险与回滚**：只新增两个可选字段，原有英文句子一字不变；回滚即还原这一个 commit。引擎读的是平台改写过的表达式时不给位置（宁缺不错）。
- **先看**：`packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts`（`compileCel` 与 `celFaultRange` 的「只在读的是作者原文时给位置」判断）、`packages/formula/src/validate.ts`（`invalid-cel` 分支）、`packages/formula/src/expression-refusal.ts`（新字段的契约说明）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/formula exec vitest run src/cel-fault-kind-position.test.ts`，预期 15 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `invalid-cel` params (`ExpressionRefusalParams`) gain two **optional** members beside `role` and `detail`:
  - `celCode`: cel-js's own structured code for the fault, read off the error object (`ParseError#code` / `TypeError#code`), never out of its prose. Parser codes for a syntax fault (`unexpected_token`, `expected_token`, `unexpected_character`, `unterminated_string`, `invalid_exponent`, …), checker codes for a type fault (`no_such_overload`, …).
  - `pos`: `{ start, end }`, the range cel-js reports, as UTF-16 offsets into `source` with `end` exclusive. A missing `)` reads `start === end === source.length`.
- `EvalError.pos`, declared and never filled, is now filled by `celEngine.compile` and `celEngine.evaluate` for a cel-js parse, check or evaluation fault that carries a range.
- Neither member is ever guessed. Both are absent when the engine reported none (`expression_must_be_string`, a native throw such as `matches()`'s regex `SyntaxError`). `pos` is also absent when cel-js read a source the platform rewrote first (the #3306 null-guard ternary lowering, the #25267 indexed `has()` lowering, the evaluate-time temporal-equality rewrite): a range into reserialized text would point at characters the author never wrote.
- The code reaches `validateExpression` through a package-internal `compileCel(source)`, which `celEngine.compile` now delegates to. It is not re-exported from the package entry, and the code is kept off `EvalError` on purpose: `EvalError` reaches logs and error bodies, where a second `code` beside an ADR-0112 `error.code` would read as one.
- `expression-refusal.ts`'s contract gains one clause: a LOCATOR param is a structured reading of the fault `detail` renders, the one exception to "params are the interpolated values".

The refusal's `message` is byte-identical, and every other code (`cel-too-large`, `cel-method-call`, `cel-unknown-function`, `cel-template-brace`, …) keeps its params unchanged. Adding `pos` to those four from the same read would be one line each; it is left out because no reader asks for it yet.

## Tests

- New `packages/formula/src/cel-fault-kind-position.test.ts`, 15 cases:
  - five parse-fault kinds through `validateExpression`: unexpected end (`record.rating >=`), missing `)` (`(record.a > 1 && record.b < 2`), unexpected character mid-source (`record.a # 1`), stray `)` (`record.a > 1 )`), unterminated string (`record.a == 'abc`). Each pins `celCode`, `pos`, the text `source.slice(start, end)` points at (`#`, `)`, `'abc`, or empty at `source.length`), and the message byte for byte as our words around the engine's pass-through `detail`;
  - a type fault (`1 + 'a'` → `no_such_overload`, `{0, 7}`);
  - absence over a rewritten source, with a positive control that the source really is rewritten;
  - `EvalError.pos` on `compile` (parse, missing `)`, check, rewritten → absent) and on `evaluate` (parse, runtime `No such key` pinned to `missing`, rewritten → absent, native throw → absent).
- **Red on base** `9da2f4b0`: 11 failed, 2 passed (the two absence controls hold on base by construction).
- `expression-refusal-codes.test.ts`: the two `invalid-cel` pins now include the new members (that table pins params exactly), and the sweep judges the locator params by what they are (`invalid-cel` only, a snake_case cel-js code, a range inside the source) instead of by message containment.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset level.** The dispatch order asked for `minor`; the changeset is `patch`. AGENTS.md ties the level to the `Metadata-protocol` kind alone, and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `none` beside a `minor`. Nothing a metadata author writes changes here, so `none` + `patch`.
- **The ui's plain-word mapping and caret** are the reader that acts on these members (Studio/Setup CEL editors, `celAuthoring.ts`); that is ui-lane work and out of this diff.
- cel-js names which token it expected (`Expected RPAREN, got EOF`) only in prose; the structured `celCode` is `expected_token` without the token. An editor that wants to say "a closing bracket" specifically has `pos` (end of source) and `detail`; a structured expected token would need cel-js upstream.
